request: The prefix, suffix, contains and case-insensitive contains predicates match the given text literally on every dialect: any %, _ or backslash in that text is escaped in the LIKE pattern so it matches only itself, while the wildcards the predicate itself adds keep working.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: dialect/sql: fix escape issue occurred in fuzzy testing (#3115)
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
